## codegen-promote-orphans-renamed-outputs  (gotcha, verified)
Renaming a file in the expression codegen's TARGETS.files leaves the old generated file committed forever, and check-drift cannot see it.

- source/tools/expression/src/build.js

## complexity-guards-measure-cpu-time  (gotcha, verified)
Growth-ratio test guards must time with process.cpuUsage(), not performance.now(), or they flake under the full parallel turbo test run.

- source/packages/model/src/scope.test.ts
- source/packages/layout/src/layout.test.ts
- source/turbo.json

## identity-keeping-has-two-paths-on-purpose  (invariant, verified)
alignIdentity (setText) and replaceContent (restoreVersion) must not be unified — only the compare-first one preserves typed bytes.

- source/packages/services/src/workflow.ts
- source/packages/services/src/editing.ts

## npm-trusted-publisher-needs-an-existing-name  (gotcha, suspect)
A new publishable package cannot release over OIDC until its name exists on npm and a trusted publisher bound to environment npm-release is enrolled by hand.

- .github/workflows/release.yml

## provenance-needs-repository-field  (gotcha, suspect)
The repository field in each published package.json is load-bearing — npm publish --provenance refuses a manifest whose repository.url does not match the building repo.

- source/packages/*/package.json
- source/sdk/js/package.json
- .github/workflows/release.yml

## read-only-comes-only-from-usereadonly  (invariant, verified)
Every editing surface in layouts/ derives read-only from useReadOnly(), never from workflow.claimed, or a Preview renders as editable.

- source/packages/react/src/layouts/*.tsx
- source/packages/react/src/theme/readOnly.ts

## region-walks-are-two-and-must-agree  (invariant, verified)
A container's child regions are enumerated twice — regionsOf on the typed tree, stepEntriesIn on the raw AST — and nothing makes them agree.

- source/packages/model/src/tree.ts
- source/packages/services/src/ast.ts
- source/packages/services/src/blocks.ts

## resolve-and-validate-agree-only-by-convention  (gotcha, verified)
resolve.ts and validate.ts re-derive the same operator/function rules independently; only hand-written conformance scenarios in two directories catch drift.
